knowledge:
- key_parameters: rank=The number of levels in one changing direction during discretization (default is 1, which classifies genes into down-regulated, unchanged, and up-regulated; higher ranks allow more granular levels) ;; seed=An object containing pairs of genes sharing expression patterns, generated by generateSeeds, used to initialize the biclustering process ;; discretized matrix=The discretized expression matrix (e.g., from quantileDiscretize) required by the biclustering algorithm
- alternatives: Quantitative biclustering algorithms such as CC (Cheng and Church) and BIMAX (implemented in the biclust package) are alternatives; rqubic is preferred when the data contains outliers, heavy tails, or when integrating other discretized data types like RNA-seq differential expression results from edgeR or DESeq.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you want to identify co-regulated gene expression patterns (biclusters of genes and conditions) in transcriptomics data using a qualitative, rule-based heuristic approach.
- pitfalls: The seed generation step (generateSeeds) can be computationally slow and memory-intensive if the input matrix contains a large number of features (e.g., >10,000 genes in human microarray experiments). Additionally, there is no guarantee that all features or conditions will be included in the resulting biclusters.

workflows.name: qualitative_biclustering_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform qualitative biclustering on gene expression data from an ExpressionSet object.
input: BicatYeast (matrix of yeast gene expression data)
demo.exprs (ExpressionSet containing the expression matrix and sample metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Load required libraries and prepare the ExpressionSet with sample metadata ;; 2. Discretize the expression data using quantile discretization ;; 3. Generate seeds from the discretized matrix ;; 4. Identify biclusters using the heuristic QUBIC algorithm ;; 5. Visualize the identified biclusters using parallel coordinates plots
workflows.code:
library(rqubic)
library(Biobase)
library(biclust)
data(BicatYeast)
demo.exprs <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs=BicatYeast)

demo.cond.split <- strsplit(sub("\\.CEL", "", colnames(BicatYeast)), "_")
demo.group <- sapply(demo.cond.split, function(x) paste(x[-length(x)], collapse="_"))
demo.time <- sapply(demo.cond.split, function(x) x[length(x)])

pData(demo.exprs) <- data.frame(group=demo.group,
                                time=demo.time)
sampleNames(demo.exprs) <- paste(demo.group, demo.time)

demo.disc <- quantileDiscretize(demo.exprs)

demo.seed <- generateSeeds(demo.disc)

demo.bic <- quBicluster(demo.seed, demo.disc)

parallelCoordinates(BicatYeast, demo.bic, number=3, plotBoth=FALSE, 
                    compare=TRUE, col="#004495", pch=1)
